description.value:
Range reach

Duration constant

Allies within reach gain a bonus to their first save or AC against a Named target's next attack.

Your Static prickles and the people beside you learn to read it. An ally within your reach gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against a Named target's next attack against it, or to its first saving throw against a Named target's effect, whichever comes first. Each ally benefits once per Named target per encounter.

cinderfall.incomplete: This affects another creature's own roll, HP, item, or condition from the card holder's self-held passive/item, which has no rule-element hook in real pf2e. Specifically: grants a bonus to an ally's AC or save sourced from the wardbreaker's own passive item, consumed once per ally per Named target -- no selector exists for granting an ally a buff from this actor's item, and the single-use trigger split across two different roll types (AC vs. saves) has no matching consumption-tracking precedent either.
